documents.PAMFR: IHE PAM FR 2.11.2 (IHE France, PAM National Extension)
documents.DTFR: IHE ITI TF-2 Appendix N.FR 1.8.2 (IHE France, Constraints on common HL7 v2.5 data types for ITI Integration Profiles in France)
documents.ITI: IHE ITI TF-2 Revision 20.0 (IHE International, IT Infrastructure Technical Framework Volume 2)

iti30Zsegments.comment: PAMFR 4.3 adds ZFA, ZFD and ZFS to ITI-30 but does not say where. They are inserted after PV2 in A28 and A31, as in the ADT_A05 table of PAMFR 5.2. A40 and A47 have no PV2 and do not receive them until the position is clarified (InteropSanté point 12). Usage O (CP-ITI-FR-2016-126 and CP-ITI-FR-2016-127).

iti31Zsegments.comment: Order and placement after PV2 from the ADT_A05 table of PAMFR 5.2; usage O except ZBE (CP-ITI-FR-2016-126 and CP-ITI-FR-2016-127). Messages: ZBE in A01, A02, A03, A04, A05, A06, A07, A11, A12, A13, A14, A15, A16, A21, A22, A25, A26, A27, A38, A52, A53, A54, A55 and Z99 (ITI 3.31.5.6; the Historic Movement option is required in France, PAMFR 2.2); ITI 3.31.5.6 explicitly excludes this option for the Temporary Patient Transfers Tracking messages A09, A10, A32 and A33. ZFA, ZFP and ZFD in A01, A04, A05, A14 and Z99 (PAMFR 6.14, 6.15, 6.18); ZFV in A01, A02, A03, A04, A05, A14, A21 and Z99 (PAMFR 6.16); ZFM in A01, A02, A03, A04, A05, A06, A14, A21, A22 and Z99 (PAMFR 6.17); ZFS in A01, A04, A05, A14 and Z99, like ZFA and ZFD (PAMFR 6.19 does not list the ITI-31 messages; ZFS is in the ADT_A05 table of PAMFR 5.2).

pda.comment: PDA is in the ADT_A05 tables of IHE ITI TF-2 and PAMFR 5.2, but not in HL7 2.5 ADT_A05: accepted deviation.

EI.1.comment: French national extension (DTFR N.2). IHE ITI TF-2 Appendix N.2 constrains EI-1 to 16 characters (revisions 13.0 to 20.0) and allows national extensions up to 199; DTFR N.2 states 128 "as for IHE international".

HD.3.comment: Table 0301 (Universal ID Type), as in the text of DTFR N.3, HL7 2.5 and IHE ITI TF-2 Appendix N.3. The table of DTFR N.3 gives 203, a leftover of CP-ITI-FR-2008-007b.

MOP.1.comment: Table 0146 replaces table 0148 for IN3-5.1 (CP-ITI-FR-2015-113). The constraint is on the datatype, so it also applies to RMC.4.1 (IN2-28). PAMFR 6.20.1 still refers to table 0148.

TS.1.comment: TS.1 stays R [1..1], as in HL7 2.5 and IHE ITI TF-2 Appendix N.5. The table of DTFR N.5 gives R [0..1]: R implies a minimum of 1.

XAD.7.comment: Valid values in France are a subset of HL7 table 0190 (Address Type), listed in DTFR N.6.

XAD.9.comment: Required when the INS is sent with a qualified identity: condition on the message content, evaluated at validation time (DTFR N.6).

XCN.10.comment: Condition: required as soon as at least one of XCN-2 and XCN-3 is valued (DTFR N.8). Evaluated at validation time.

XON.8.comment: DTFR N.9 table gives X [0..1]; X implies a maximum of 0.

XPN.1.comment: DTFR N.10 table gives C [0..1]; its text says "required if known" (RE), as in IHE ITI TF-2 Appendix N.6 (RE). The family name of birth (type L) is required when the INS is sent with a qualified identity.

XPN.2.comment: Condition: for an identity created or modified by a call to the INSi teleservice, the first given name of the list returned by the teleservice must be extracted; the component is then required (DTFR N.10).

XTN.4.comment: Condition: valued with an email address when XTN-2 is NET (network email address) (DTFR N.11). Evaluated at validation time.

XTN.5.comment: DTFR N.11 table gives X [0..1]; X implies a maximum of 0.

XTN.12.comment: Condition: valued when XTN-2 is not NET or is empty (DTFR N.11). Contains the full telephone number, digits only with no separator, e.g. 0148587200 or +33607080910. DTFR N.11 gives +3360708091, which has 8 digits after +33 instead of 9. Evaluated at validation time.

VID.comment: VID is only used in MSH-12: version of HL7 (2.5), internationalization code (FRA) and version of the profile (2.11).

EVN.3.comment: C everywhere. IHE ITI TF-2 3.30.5.2: shall be populated in A15 and A26; the planned date/time of other planned events (A14, A16, A25, A27) is given in PV2 and is recommended to be copied to EVN-3. PAMFR 6.4: in a pending event, an empty EVN-3 means an expected event (taking place) rather than a planned one; EVN-3 therefore stays C, also in A15 and A26.

EVN.6.comment: IHE ITI TF-2 3.30.5.2: not populated in pending events and their cancellations (X in A14, A15, A16, A25, A26, A27, set per message); populated with the real date/time in effective events (inserts and updates), checked at validation time.

MSH.17.comment: IHE ITI TF-2 3.30.5.1 gives RE [1..1]; RE implies a minimum of 0.

MSH.21.comment: The message profile identifier must be sent (PAMFR 6.5); IHE ITI TF-2 3.30.5.1 gives RE [0..*]. One repetition is expected to be 2.11^IHE_FRANCE-2.11-PAM: checked at validation time.

PID.7.comment: C in PAMFR 6.6 (CE in IHE ITI TF-2 3.30.5.3). Conditions, checked at validation time: required if known in A28, A31, A01, A04 (ITI 3.30.5.3), optional in the other messages; required when the INS is sent with a qualified identity (PAMFR 6.6.4).

PID.8.comment: C in PAMFR 6.6 (CE [1..1] in IHE ITI TF-2 3.30.5.3). Conditions, checked at validation time: required if known in A28, A31, A01, A04 (ITI 3.30.5.3), optional in the other messages; required when the INS is sent with a qualified identity (PAMFR 6.6.5).

PID.11.comment: C in PAMFR 6.6 (CE in IHE ITI TF-2 3.30.5.3). The ITI 3.30.5.3 condition depends only on the message: RE in A28, A31, A01, A04 and O in the other ADT messages, set per message.

PID.18.comment: C in PAMFR 6.6; required in the ITI-31 messages (PAMFR 6.6.9), set per message. IHE ITI TF-2 3.30.5.3: PID-18 or PV1-19 is valued in ITI-31.

PID.33.comment: C in PAMFR 6.6 (CE in IHE ITI TF-2 3.30.5.3). RE in A28, A31, A01, A04, set per message (ITI 3.30.5.3); ITI gives no value for the other messages, which keep C. In A31, equal to EVN-6 (checked at validation time).

PV2.3.comment: PAMFR 6.11 table gives X [0..1]; X implies a maximum of 0.

NK1.11.comment: JCC.1 uses table 0327 and JCC.2 table 0328 (HL7 2.5), already set on the JCC components.

EVN.6.comment: EVN-6 shall not be populated in messages communicating pending events (A14, A15, A16) and their cancellations (A27, A26, A25) (ITI 3.30.5.2).

PID.31.comment: Optional outside A28, A31, A01, A04 (ITI 3.30.5.3: "In all other messages, it is optional").
Required if known in A28, A31, A01, A04 (ITI 3.30.5.3); CE in PAMFR 6.6 (CP-ITI-FR-2015-110: the field cannot be forbidden).

PID.18.comment: PID-18 (account number, NDA) is required in France in the context of ITI-31 (PAMFR 6.6.9); IHE ITI TF-2 3.30.5.3 only requires PID-18 or PV1-19.

default.comment: Pseudo-PV1: in ITI-30 only PV1-2 (Patient Class) is valued, with value N (checked at validation time).

PV2.7.comment: The coordinated care indicator is required by the regulation in A04 and A07, i.e. for outpatients (PAMFR 6.11.3); RE in the PAMFR 6.20.1 table. In Z99, it depends on ZBE-6 (checked at validation time).

structure.comment: The ROL segment following PID/PD1 carries the attending physician (ROL-3 = ODRP); it is required in A01 and A04 when the attending physician is known.
NK1 is RE in A28, A01, A04 and Z99 when Z99 updates an A01 or an A04 (PAMFR 6.9).
The ROL segment following PID/PD1 carries the attending physician (ROL-3 = ODRP); it is required in A01 and A04 when the attending physician is known.
NK1 is RE in A28, A01, A04 and Z99 when Z99 updates an A01 or an A04 (PAMFR 6.9).
IHE ITI TF-2 3.31.7.7.2 gives PV2 X; the ADT_A05 table of PAMFR 5.2 gives PV2 O [0..1].
IHE ITI TF-2 3.31.7.10.2 gives PV2 X; PAMFR 6.11.3 requires the coordinated care indicator PV2-7 in A07, so PV2 is allowed.

IHE ITI TF-2 3.31.7.13.2 gives PV2 X; PAMFR 6.11.10 requires PV2-38 if known in A14, so PV2 is allowed. IHE ITI TF-2 3.30.5.2 (EVN-3) also says that Pending Admit gives the planned date/time in a PV2 field.

PV2.47.comment: Expected return date of the leave of absence, sent with A21 (PAMFR 6.11.11); C in the PAMFR 6.11 table, no value given for the other messages.

structure.comment: NK1 is RE in A28, A01, A04 and Z99 (PAMFR 6.9). It is also sent in A31 and A05 (PAMFR 6.9.2) with usage O; a NK1 for a trusted person (NK1-7 = K) is only sent in ITI-31.
IHE ITI TF-2 3.31.7.8.2 gives DRG O [0..*]; HL7 2.5 ADT_A38 gives [0..1].
Only one merge operation per message.
IHE ITI TF-2 puts PID, PD1 and MRG in a PATIENT group [1..1]; HL7 2.5 ADT_A30 has no group. The ER7 message is the same.
Condition: RE when the corrected movement was created by A01 or A04 (ZBE-6), O otherwise. Evaluated at validation time.

ADT^Z99.comment: ROL (after PID/PD1) and PV2 keep usage O (IHE ITI TF-2 3.31.7.30.2); NK1 is C (PAMFR 6.9). Their use depends on the original trigger event of the corrected movement (ZBE-6), checked at validation time: ROL is required if known when ZBE-6 is A01 or A04 (PAMFR 6.8.6); NK1 is required if known when ZBE-6 is A01 or A04 (PAMFR 6.9); PV2 follows its usage in the message of the original event (X for A03, A06; RE for A16; O for A05, A07, A14).
